headline: 14,384 primary teachers to join on October 1
summary: The Ministry of Primary and Mass Education has announced the joining date, but selected candidates are continuing their protests for a specific posting date.
details: The Ministry of Primary and Mass Education has announced that 14,384 successfully selected candidates for the 'Assistant Teacher Recruitment-2025' will join their respective district primary education offices on October 1.
Following the announcement, the ministry stated that appointment letters will be sent to the candidates in due time, and posting and training will follow after joining.
Despite the announcement, the selected candidates are continuing their sit-in protests in Dhaka, demanding a specific date for their actual school postings.
The protesters, who gathered at the National Museum in Shahbag, claim that the process has seen no progress for six months despite completing health checks and certificate verification in early 2026.
The candidates were finally selected on February 8, 2026, and completed their medical tests, including dope tests, between February 22 and March 1 of the same year.
caption:
14,384 new primary teachers are set to join on October 1, but protests continue over posting dates.

The Ministry of Primary and Mass Education has announced that 14,384 successfully selected candidates for the 'Assistant Teacher Recruitment-2025' will join their respective district primary education offices on October 1.

Following the announcement, the ministry stated that appointment letters will be sent to the candidates in due time, and posting and training will follow after joining.

Despite the announcement, the selected candidates are continuing their sit-in protests in Dhaka, demanding a specific date for their actual school postings.

The protesters, who gathered at the National Museum in Shahbag, claim that the process has seen no progress for six months despite completing health checks and certificate verification in early 2026.

The candidates were finally selected on February 8, 2026, and completed their medical tests, including dope tests, between February 22 and March 1 of the same year.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo, The Daily Star

headline: Dhaka: Man kills wife and mother-in-law after argument
summary: A man allegedly stabbed his wife and her mother to death in Dhaka's Kalabagan area following a domestic dispute.
details: A man has allegedly killed his wife and mother-in-law in Dhaka's Kalabagan area. Police have detained the suspect, identified as Hridoy alias Shipon.
The incident occurred around 9:30 am at a residence near Al-Amin Jame Masjid in Kathalbagan.
According to police, the tragedy was triggered by an argument between the couple. Firoza, the mother-in-law, intervened to stop the quarrel and sided with her daughter.
The suspect then allegedly stabbed his wife before attacking his mother-in-law, resulting in the deaths of both women.
caption:
A domestic argument in Dhaka's Kalabagan turned fatal as a man allegedly killed his wife and mother-in-law.

A man has allegedly killed his wife and mother-in-law in Dhaka's Kalabagan area. Police have detained the suspect, identified as Hridoy alias Shipon.

The incident occurred around 9:30 am at a residence near Al-Amin Jame Masjid in Kathalbagan.

According to police, the tragedy was triggered by an argument between the couple. Firoza, the mother-in-law, intervened to stop the quarrel and sided with her daughter.

The suspect then allegedly stabbed his wife before attacking his mother-in-law, resulting in the deaths of both women.
